CS Launcher Plus has no analytics, no tracking and no servers of its own. Nothing about you, your device or how you play is sent to CRAFT STUDIO. Your accounts, settings, worlds and mods stay on your device, inside the app\'s private storage.

The internet is used only to download what you ask for: the game and its libraries from Mojang / Microsoft, Java runtimes, mod loaders (Forge, Fabric, Quilt, NeoForge), and content from Modrinth and CurseForge. Logging in talks directly to Microsoft, Xbox Live and Mojang (or Ely.by) — your password never passes through us.

Game and launcher logs are saved locally so you can troubleshoot. They may contain your username and device details. They leave your device only if you choose Share log, which uploads to mclo.gs — a third-party service with its own policy — and you can delete the paste there.

Notifications keep downloads alive in the background. Files you import (skins, mods, modpacks, worlds) are opened through the Android picker, so no broad storage access is needed. The launcher never asks for your contacts, location, camera or microphone.

Microsoft, Mojang, Ely.by, Modrinth, CurseForge, mclo.gs and Discord are independent services governed by their own terms and privacy policies. Mods, modpacks, shaders and worlds are made by their authors; please respect their licenses.

CS Launcher Plus is an independent project and is not affiliated with Mojang Studios or Microsoft. You need a legitimate Minecraft: Java Edition account to play online, and you agree to follow the Minecraft EULA. Offline profiles are for single-player and private servers you are allowed to join.
